mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust demand conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (e.g., following a sharp increase in unemployment), a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that support corporate hiring and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during post-shock recovery when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction permit rate (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity that stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 3.0% annualized signals disinflation, reducing the risk of aggressive rate hikes and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.0% within a 3-month period signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls below 3.0% within 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
